newsitem.title: USA: Good deed lands Ohio grandmother in jail.
newsitem.headline: Good deed lands Ohio grandmother in jail.

text.p: A grandmother who tried to help a stranger by feeding a parking meter wound up in jail instead.

"I've never been arrested for anything before," Sylvia Spayton, 62, told reporters on Friday as she left Hamilton County Municipal Court, where she was arraigned on charges of obstructing official business and disorderly conduct.
She was arrested on Thursday evening by a police officer who saw her put coins in an expired meter. She said she did not know who owned the car but thought she would help out.
"He started to write a parking ticket after I put the money in the meter," she said. "He said I was interfering with his duties."
The dispute landed Spayton in jail for three hours before family members bailed her out. She was released on a $1,500 bond.
The policeman involved in the case declined comment.
